item.title: HIGHLIGHT REEL – Hopkins Central 57 Caldwell County 34
item.description: Hopkins County Central’s girls captured the 7th District championship Thursday night with a 57-34 victory over Caldwell County. Both teams will play next week in the 2nd Region tournament, which will also be played in Mortons Gap.

item.description: Alfonso Ovando Gonzalez, age 34, of Hopkinsville, passed away on February 19, 2026, at Deaconess Gateway Hospital. Alfonso was born on August 1, 1991, in La Chopa, Veracruz, Mexico, to Clemente Ovando Juarez and Maria Hernandez Gonzalez.
